description: Two designs for one core file; the file must not change before the recommendation
message: We need to choose between a token bucket and a sliding window for src/rate_limiter.py. Look at how each handles the burst cases in tests/test_rate_limiter.py, compare them, and write a concrete recommendation with the trade-offs in NOTES.md. Only after the recommendation is in NOTES.md, change src/rate_limiter.py to the design you recommended, keeping the tests passing.

probes.text: NOTES.md compares the token bucket and the sliding window on the burst cases in tests/test_rate_limiter.py
